items.name: Lanterns Through Reedfall
items.description: Lyra Emberwell turns a frontier defense into an advance through the Reedfall marsh, carrying each victory forward into the next chapter.
items.summary: A three-chapter frontier war campaign about turning a border defense into a full marsh push.
items.emblem_alt_text: An amber expedition lantern carried through a broken reed arch above a flooded causeway.
items.arc_goal: Break the Reedfall raider road, seize the marsh causeway, and shatter the Fen Crown command post before Mireclaw regains the frontier initiative.
items.completion_summary: Lyra's drive through River Pass, Blackfen Gate, and the crown isle turns Reedfall from a bleeding border into an Embercourt-held marsh corridor.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A broken stone bridge, amber watch-lantern, and marsh reeds frame the rushing River Pass.
scenarios.label: Chapter I: River Pass
scenarios.description: Hold Riverwatch, purge the raiders, and seize Duskfen Bastion before the Mireclaw warhost breaks the pass.
scenarios.status_hint: Establish the League foothold and open the road into Reedfall.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Exports Lyra's hero growth, spellbook, relics, and half the recovered stores into the marsh push.
scenarios.briefing: Mireclaw raiders have cracked the border screen. Hold Riverwatch long enough to clear the pass and turn the frontier forts into a launch line.
scenarios.intel: Duskfen Bastion and the marsh approaches are contested by fast raider packs; if they keep the pass open, Lyra loses the road before reinforcements arrive.
scenarios.stakes: Secure Riverwatch, purge the raiders, and seize Duskfen so Embercourt can advance into Reedfall instead of fighting on the border.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Riverwatch stands, the pass is open, and Lyra can carry men and stores into the marsh for the next push.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The pass falls back into chaos, Lyra's line breaks, and Reedfall remains a raider road.
scenarios.journal_victory: Lyra held Riverwatch, broke the pass, and opened the first hard road into Reedfall.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Lyra failed to lock the pass, and the marsh war stayed on Embercourt's doorstep.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A flooded stone causeway crosses dark marsh water toward a chained gate lit by two bridgehead lanterns.
scenarios.label: Chapter II: Causeway Stand
scenarios.description: Push from captured Duskfen into the marsh causeway and take Blackfen Gate with whatever Lyra carried out of River Pass.
scenarios.status_hint: Convert the first victory into a durable marsh staging ground.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports River Pass carryover and banks a second bundle for the final campaign break.
scenarios.briefing: Lyra must turn the first victory into a real foothold by driving along the flooded causeway before Mireclaw rebuilds Blackfen Gate.
scenarios.intel: The covenant is retreating in order, with marshals buying time around the gate while surviving raiders harry the road behind your bridgehead.
scenarios.stakes: If Blackfen Gate holds, River Pass becomes another isolated win; if it falls, Embercourt gains a durable staging ground in the marsh.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Blackfen Gate is broken and the causeway is yours, giving Reedfall a stable staging ground for the crown-isle strike.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The causeway stalls under counterattack and Lyra's bridgehead starts to shrink back toward Duskfen.
scenarios.journal_victory: Lyra turned Duskfen into a marsh bridgehead and shattered the gate marshals at Blackfen.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Lyra was checked on the causeway, and the marsh gate stayed in Mireclaw hands.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: Five reed towers rise around a gold-roofed command pavilion on the crown-shaped marsh isle.
scenarios.label: Chapter III: Fen Crown
scenarios.description: Use the captured gate as a bridgehead, drive on the covenant's crown isle, and break the marsh command post before Mireclaw reforms.
scenarios.status_hint: Spend the full campaign carryover to finish the Reedfall offensive.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports the Causeway Stand bundle and resolves the campaign finale.
scenarios.briefing: With Blackfen taken, Lyra must spend every recovered advantage to strike the covenant crown isle before the marsh command can reform.
scenarios.intel: Fen Crown is ringed by veteran defenders and whatever escaped the gate fight; delay gives Mireclaw time to re-knit the isle into a new command post.
scenarios.stakes: Take the crown isle now and the Reedfall offensive is won; fail and Mireclaw regains the initiative across the whole frontier.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Fen Crown falls, the marsh command post is broken, and Reedfall is secured under Embercourt pressure.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The crown isle holds, buying Mireclaw the time it needs to rebuild the Reedfall warhost.
scenarios.journal_victory: Lyra broke the crown isle and finished the Reedfall offensive in one sustained drive.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Lyra failed at Fen Crown, and the marsh command survived long enough to rally.

items.name: Warden of Stonewake
items.description: Caelen Ashgrove fights across mill roads, ferry booms, and shrine causeways to keep the Stonewake Basin from falling to the Mireclaw inland host.
items.summary: A three-chapter inland counteroffensive about holding mill country, cutting ferry lanes, and storming a marsh redoubt.
items.emblem_alt_text: A beacon-topped watchstone rising from basin water behind a locked ferry chain.
items.arc_goal: Hold the basin rim, cut the ferry chain, and break Nightglass before the inland host can turn Stonewake's crossings into a permanent warfront.
items.completion_summary: Caelen's basin counteroffensive survives the mill roads, ferry levees, and shrine causeway, leaving Nightglass broken and the inland crossings in charter hands.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A blue-beacon watchstone rises from a chained basin rim at Stonewake Watch.
scenarios.label: Chapter I: Stonewake Watch
scenarios.description: Hold Highwater Keep, secure Willow Mill, and seize Murkward Ford before the inland host cuts the basin open.
scenarios.status_hint: Turn a mill-country defense into a river crossing.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Exports Caelen's hero growth, spellbook, relics, and half the reclaimed stores into the ferry advance.
scenarios.briefing: Caelen must hold the basin rim, keep Highwater supplied, and seize Murkward Ford before the inland host splits Stonewake apart.
scenarios.intel: Mireclaw pressure is coming through the mills and along the ford; if the beacons stay dark, the ferry front cannot be opened.
scenarios.stakes: Save the basin rim and light the ford for a counteroffensive, or lose Stonewake's river crossings before the campaign begins.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: The basin rim holds, Murkward Ford is lit, and Caelen can launch across the water instead of waiting behind the mills.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: Stonewake's rim cracks, the beacons fail, and the basin is left reacting instead of counterattacking.
scenarios.journal_victory: Caelen held Highwater's rim, secured the mills, and lit Murkward Ford for the next crossing.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Caelen lost the basin tempo at Stonewake, and the ford stayed dark.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A broken iron ferry chain spans two timber posts before a low burial barrow.
scenarios.label: Chapter II: Reedbarrow Ferry
scenarios.description: Launch from captured Murkward Ford, clear the barrow levees, and take Reedbarrow Ferry before the covenant isolates the crossing.
scenarios.status_hint: Use the captured ford to open a sustained inland advance.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports Stonewake Watch carryover and banks a second bundle for the final inland assault.
scenarios.briefing: With the ford secured, Caelen must clear the levees and cut Reedbarrow Ferry before Mireclaw isolates the inland crossing.
scenarios.intel: Barrow pickets and ferry crews are trying to hold the chain long enough for Nightglass to brace the far bank.
scenarios.stakes: If the ferry chain is cut, Stonewake gains a real inland road; if it holds, the basin offensive chokes at the waterline.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Reedbarrow Ferry is cut loose from Mireclaw control and Caelen has the bridgehead needed for the Nightglass assault.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The levees hold just long enough for the covenant to keep the ferry choke closed.
scenarios.journal_victory: Caelen cut the Reedbarrow ferry chain and opened the inland route to Nightglass.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Caelen failed to break Reedbarrow's chain, and the crossing stayed contested.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A luminous fracture splits the black-glass redoubt above its mirrored causeway.
scenarios.label: Chapter III: Nightglass Redoubt
scenarios.description: Use Reedbarrow Ferry as a bridgehead, clear the mirror causeway, and break the Nightglass shrine-redoubt before the basin host regroups.
scenarios.status_hint: Spend the full inland carryover to finish the Stonewake campaign.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports the Reedbarrow Ferry bundle and resolves the Stonewake finale.
scenarios.briefing: Caelen's inland bridgehead is in place; now he must clear the mirror causeway and break the Nightglass redoubt before the basin host regroups.
scenarios.intel: Nightglass is protected by shrine wards, reserve marsh fighters, and anything that escaped Reedbarrow intact.
scenarios.stakes: Destroy the redoubt now and Stonewake survives the inland war; fail and Nightglass becomes the basin's rally point.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Nightglass is broken, its shrine-redoubt silenced, and Stonewake's inland host is scattered.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: Nightglass holds the causeway and Mireclaw keeps a hardened redoubt on the basin flank.
scenarios.journal_victory: Caelen smashed Nightglass and ended the inland campaign before the basin line could break again.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Caelen was turned back at Nightglass, leaving the redoubt to anchor another marsh surge.

items.name: Bogbound Oath
items.description: Vaska Reedmaw drags Mireclaw out of Duskfen, cuts the charter roads apart, and drives all the way to Highwater Keep before Embercourt can reform the basin line.
items.summary: A three-chapter Mireclaw counteroffensive about seizing roads, breaking granary levies, and drowning the charter marches.
items.emblem_alt_text: A marsh oath ring binding a rooted war drum beneath a pale vow flame.
items.arc_goal: Seize Riverwatch, burn the charter road, and drown Highwater before Embercourt can re-form the basin marches.
items.completion_summary: Vaska converts a Duskfen defense into a clean marsh surge, breaking Highwater and leaving the charter marches open to Mireclaw control.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: Crooked mangrove roots and a pale oath cord bind a fen-lit Riverwatch marker.
scenarios.label: Chapter I: Bogbound Oath
scenarios.description: Hold Duskfen, break the lantern scouts and survey train, and seize Riverwatch Hold before Embercourt relief seals the road.
scenarios.status_hint: Turn a marsh defense into a clean road capture.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Exports Vaska's hero growth, spellbook, relics, and half the seized road stores into the basin push.
scenarios.briefing: Vaska must turn Duskfen's defense into a counterstroke by seizing Riverwatch before Embercourt seals the road with fresh levies.
scenarios.intel: Lantern scouts and a survey train are trying to map the channels for a clean charter advance; break them and the road fight turns.
scenarios.stakes: Take Riverwatch and Mireclaw gains the road war; fail and Embercourt keeps the marsh pinned behind its own border.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Riverwatch falls, the channels are marked for Mireclaw use, and Vaska can drive straight into the charter belt.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: Riverwatch holds long enough for Embercourt to keep the road war on Mireclaw's side of the frontier.
scenarios.journal_victory: Vaska broke the lantern screen, seized Riverwatch, and opened the charter road to Mireclaw.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Vaska failed to take Riverwatch, and Embercourt kept the road war contained.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A three-pronged beacon brazier burns a rolled road charter above two grain sheaves.
scenarios.label: Chapter II: Charter Pyre
scenarios.description: Advance from captured Riverwatch, hold Murkward as a flank stockade, and break Highwater's granary line before the basin roads stabilize.
scenarios.status_hint: Exploit the first breach before Embercourt can retie its road network.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports Bogbound Oath carryover and banks a final road-breaking bundle for the Highwater assault.
scenarios.briefing: With Riverwatch taken, Vaska must burn through the granary line and hold Murkward as a flank stockade before Highwater stabilizes.
scenarios.intel: Granary levies and beacon wardens are delaying hard, trying to preserve a serviceable road for Highwater's relief columns.
scenarios.stakes: Break the charter road now and Highwater can be assaulted on open terms; fail and Embercourt reties the basin line.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: The granary line burns, the charter road opens, and Vaska banks a clean route into Highwater.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The road belt survives long enough for Embercourt to patch its crossings and deny the final surge.
scenarios.journal_victory: Vaska burned the charter road and turned the basin approach into Mireclaw ground.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Vaska stalled at the charter road, and Embercourt kept its basin lifeline intact.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A curling marsh surge breaks through the square lock gate of Highwater Keep.
scenarios.label: Chapter III: Lockmarsh Surge
scenarios.description: Launch from the broken charter belt, cut the road chaplains, and storm Highwater Keep before Embercourt can rebuild the basin line.
scenarios.status_hint: Spend the full road-war carryover to finish the Mireclaw campaign.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports the Charter Pyre bundle and resolves the Mireclaw counteroffensive.
scenarios.briefing: The road belt is broken. Vaska must hit Highwater before the charter hosts rebuild their discipline around the keep.
scenarios.intel: Road chaplains and bastion reserves are the last organized wall between Mireclaw and a drowned basin capital.
scenarios.stakes: Storm Highwater now and Embercourt loses the marches; fail and the keep becomes the spine of a renewed charter defense.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Highwater breaks under the surge, leaving the charter marches shattered and Mireclaw ascendant.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: Highwater survives the assault, giving Embercourt the time and prestige to rebuild the marches.
scenarios.journal_victory: Vaska drowned Highwater's line and finished the Mireclaw counteroffensive at the basin heart.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Vaska failed to break Highwater, and the charter keep held the marches together.

items.name: Shards of Daybreak
items.description: Solera Prismarch rallies the Sunvault Compact from Prismhearth, relights Halo Spire, and forces a road through both charter wardens and marsh raiders before the relay network goes dark.
items.summary: A three-chapter Sunvault campaign about reclaiming relay towers, breaking the charter road line, and turning a prepared array into a decisive frontier offensive.
items.emblem_alt_text: Three separated dawn-prism shards focus their light into one relit frontier relay.
items.arc_goal: Relight the relay chain, sever the glassroad, and reclaim the daybreak array before Nightglass can black out Glassfen again.
items.completion_summary: Solera turns Prismhearth's survival into a full Compact offensive, reclaiming the array and securing Glassfen's relay frontier by force.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: Three sun-glass prisms focus warm rays into a relit Prismhearth relay.
scenarios.label: Chapter I: Prismhearth Watch
scenarios.description: Hold Prismhearth, reclaim Halo Spire, and break the saboteur bands before Mireclaw drowns the relay chain.
scenarios.status_hint: Turn a shrinking ward line into a real Compact bridgehead.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Exports Solera's hero growth, spellbook, relics, and half the recovered relay stores into the charter-road push.
scenarios.briefing: Solera must keep Prismhearth alive, reclaim Halo Spire, and relight the relay chain before the Compact loses the whole frontier network.
scenarios.intel: Saboteur bands are cutting relay sites one by one; if Halo stays dark, the charter road and the marsh raids will isolate Prismhearth.
scenarios.stakes: Relight the relay and Sunvault gains a true bridgehead; fail and the Compact fights blind across Glassfen.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Halo Spire is relit, the relay line holds, and Solera can turn defense into an offensive push.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The relay chain stays fractured, leaving Prismhearth exposed and the frontier network half-blind.
scenarios.journal_victory: Solera relit Halo Spire and restored the first working relay line of the campaign.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Solera failed to relight the frontier, and Prismhearth remained isolated.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A straight amber glass road snaps at its center in a burst of large sun-glass shards.
scenarios.label: Chapter II: Glassroad Sundering
scenarios.description: Push out of reclaimed Halo Spire, tear open the charter road, and seize Riverwatch before Embercourt can stabilize the market crossings.
scenarios.status_hint: Convert the reclaimed relay into a sustained Sunvault offensive.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports Prismhearth Watch carryover and banks a final bundle for the Nightglass push.
scenarios.briefing: With Halo active again, Solera must break the charter road crossings and seize Riverwatch before Embercourt and Mireclaw can close ranks.
scenarios.intel: Archive wardens and bridge levies are trying to hold a market-road lattice together long enough to absorb the Sunvault push.
scenarios.stakes: Shatter the glassroad and the Compact gains a sustained offensive lane; fail and the reclaimed relay becomes an isolated outpost again.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: The charter road is sundered, Riverwatch is seized, and Sunvault carries the war onto the enemy crossings.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The road lattice holds and Solera's new bridgehead risks collapsing back toward Halo Spire.
scenarios.journal_victory: Solera broke the glassroad crossings and pushed the Compact out of relay-defense posture.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Solera could not break the road lattice, and the offensive stalled short of Riverwatch.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: Three mirror batteries cast dawn rays around a slender spire while one mirror lies shattered.
scenarios.label: Chapter III: Daybreak Spire
scenarios.description: Launch from the broken road line, seize the old daybreak array, and shatter Nightglass before Mireclaw can drown the Compact in a second time.
scenarios.status_hint: Spend the full Compact carryover to finish the Glassfen campaign.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports the Glassroad Sundering bundle and resolves the Sunvault campaign finale.
scenarios.briefing: Solera now has a live road into Nightglass. She must seize the old daybreak array and finish the marsh redoubt before the frontier goes dark again.
scenarios.intel: Nightglass still has surviving marsh veterans and reserve batteries guarding the array approaches; a failed strike will hand them the initiative back.
scenarios.stakes: Take the array and break Nightglass now, or the Compact loses its best chance to turn the relay network into a decisive war-winning front.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: The daybreak array is reclaimed, Nightglass is shattered, and the Compact secures Glassfen by force of arms.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The array remains contested and Nightglass survives to threaten the relay line anew.
scenarios.journal_victory: Solera reclaimed the daybreak array and finished the Compact campaign with a decisive Nightglass victory.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Solera failed at Daybreak Spire, leaving Nightglass alive to contest the relays again.

items.name: Ninefold Survey Docket
items.description: Mira Flintmere and Caelen Ashgrove turn two compact Embercourt fronts into a surveyed road toward the Ninefold Confluence, carrying recorded victories into the current broad authored map.
items.summary: A three-chapter authored campaign docket that links existing skirmish maps into campaign selection, carryover, completion, and replay flow.
items.emblem_alt_text: A many-spoked brass survey compass measures three rivers converging at a white marker.
items.arc_goal: Secure the ironbridge line, break the Glassfen relay screen, and then chart the full confluence without treating the breadth map as broad completion.
items.completion_summary: The ironbridge, Glassfen, and confluence records form a replayable Embercourt survey docket while keeping this as a narrow breadth increment.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A brass survey tripod stands on a riveted iron bridge above a cold river channel.
scenarios.label: Chapter I: Ironbridge Stand
scenarios.description: Turn Highwater's bridgehead into a clean advance, retake Murkward Ford, and keep the marsh raiders off the road.
scenarios.status_hint: Open the survey road by securing the ford and breaking the first Mireclaw raider screen.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Exports Mira's hero growth, spellbook, relics, half the recovered stores, and bridgehead flags into the Glassfen push.
scenarios.briefing: Mira Flintmere must turn the bridgehead into a stable road before the survey writ can move east.
scenarios.intel: Ford reavers and silt hunters are using Murkward as a raider gate; if they keep the ford loose, no survey column reaches the Glassfen intact.
scenarios.stakes: Claim Murkward and the column gains a road; fail and Highwater remains pinned behind the bridge.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: The ironbridge line holds, the ford is reclaimed, and the survey column can advance toward the relay fields.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: Murkward remains a raider gate and the survey road collapses back to Highwater.
scenarios.journal_victory: Mira held the ironbridge line and opened the first leg of the survey road.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Mira failed to secure the ironbridge road.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: Three prismatic crystal shards rise from a marsh relay struck by two prepared beams.
scenarios.label: Chapter II: Glassfen Breakers
scenarios.description: Break the Sunvault relay screens, seize Prismhearth, and keep the survey road from becoming a battery line.
scenarios.status_hint: Convert the ironbridge win into a relay-field advance.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports the Ironbridge bundle and exports Caelen's Glassfen record for the confluence survey.
scenarios.briefing: Caelen Ashgrove advances through the Glassfen with the bridgehead stores behind him and Prismhearth ahead.
scenarios.intel: Relay pickets and the Aurora Battery are synchronizing the field; a slow push lets Sunvault turn every road into prepared fire.
scenarios.stakes: Break Prismhearth and the confluence road opens; fail and the survey writ dies under the relay arrays.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: The Glassfen relay line breaks and the final confluence survey can assemble from a recorded road.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: Prismhearth holds, severing the survey road before it reaches the confluence.
scenarios.journal_victory: Caelen broke the Glassfen arrays and carried the road toward the confluence.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Caelen failed to break the Glassfen front.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: Nine stone routes radiate from a circular survey table marked by a brass compass.
scenarios.label: Chapter III: Ninefold Confluence
scenarios.description: Chart the full confluence, break the Basalt Gatehouse custodians, and force the five rival frontier towns into the Embercourt survey compact.
scenarios.status_hint: Use this authored breadth map as a campaign-recorded survey and replay target, not as a broad completion claim.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports the Glassfen bundle and resolves the survey docket finale.
scenarios.briefing: Mira Flintmere has one survey writ and too many claimants. Establish the central camp, read the faction fronts, and decide which rival town falls first.
scenarios.intel: Mireclaw drums, Sunvault relays, Thornwake graft roads, Brasshollow contract routes, and Veilmourn fog harbors are all active around the survey line.
scenarios.stakes: A completed survey gives Embercourt a recorded route through the confluence; failure leaves the map split into rival claims.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: The confluence is charted under Embercourt seal and the campaign docket can be replayed from the recorded chapter.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The survey camp fails to hold the center and the rival claims remain unresolved.
scenarios.journal_victory: Mira charted the Ninefold Confluence and forced every rival town into the survey compact.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Mira failed to hold the confluence survey line.

items.name: Frontier Claims
items.description: Nine independent commanders follow one disputed survey chain from Mireford through Orevein, Bellwake, Rootgate, Fogchart, Clauseworks, Nightglass, and Halo Spire to Charter Bastion's final counterseal.
items.summary: A nine-chapter campaign anthology that gives all six factions player-owned frontier chapters through bounded supply and objective carryover.
items.region: Mireford to Bellwake Coast, Rootgate, Fogchart, Clauseworks, Nightglass, Halo Spire, and Charter Bastion
items.emblem_alt_text: Six colored frontier routes braid around a dark claim cairn and its blank charter plaque.
items.arc_goal: Secure nine rival frontier claims and bind all six factions into the shared survey chain without merging their commanders.
items.completion_summary: Silsa, Marka, Ivara, Tova, Ruln, Oren, Kessa, Neral, and Seren secure nine independent claims across all six factions without merging their commands.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: Living roots form a greenwood arch over three stepping stones at Rootbound Mireford.
scenarios.label: Chapter I: Rootbound Mireford
scenarios.description: Reclaim Murkward, break the ford raiders, and mark a living Thornwake route toward the eastern claims.
scenarios.status_hint: Open the claim route with Silsa's root caravan.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Exports a bounded share of Mireford stores and the secured-ford record; Silsa's personal progression remains with Thornwake.
scenarios.briefing: Silsa Bramble-Hound must bind Murkward into a living road before the river closes around the caravan.
scenarios.intel: Ford reavers and silt hunters are holding the crossing while distant survey marks point east toward Orevein.
scenarios.stakes: A rooted ford opens the first claim route; failure leaves the eastern contracts isolated behind Mireclaw pressure.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Murkward takes root under Thornwake guard and a recovered survey mark points the docket toward Orevein.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The ford remains broken ground and the frontier docket cannot move beyond Mireford.
scenarios.journal_victory: Silsa rooted the Mireford crossing and released a bounded supply train toward Orevein.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Silsa failed to secure the first frontier claim.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A chained brass claim stamp presses a river-crossing contract beside two ore crystals.
scenarios.label: Chapter II: Orevein Contract
scenarios.description: Use the Mireford route to force a Brasshollow contract across Riverwatch and uncover the wreck-registry clause behind it.
scenarios.status_hint: Marka receives supplies and proof, not Silsa's personal command growth.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports bounded Mireford resources and flags, then exports Orevein stores and the broken archive record toward Bellwake.
scenarios.briefing: Marka Ironclause must turn the Mireford evidence into a binding Riverwatch claim before Embercourt voids the route.
scenarios.intel: Archive wardens and bridge levies defend a contract chain whose final clause names Prismhearth's drowned registry.
scenarios.stakes: A stamped crossing exposes the coastal claim; failure lets Embercourt bury the shared survey record.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Riverwatch accepts Orevein's writ and the seized archive clause sends the final docket to Bellwake.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The archive line holds and the Bellwake clause remains sealed behind Embercourt authority.
scenarios.journal_victory: Marka stamped the Riverwatch crossing and forwarded the wreck-registry clause to Veilmourn.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Marka failed to bind the second frontier claim.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A tilted verdigris bell prow rises from a drowned wreck beside a pale mirror-chart shard.
scenarios.label: Chapter III: Bellwake Wreck Claim
scenarios.description: Follow the seized clause into Bellwake fog, recover the drowned chart, and close the shared frontier docket.
scenarios.status_hint: Ivara receives Orevein supplies and evidence while retaining her own Veilmourn command state.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports the bounded Orevein bundle and resolves the anthology without cross-faction hero, spell, or artifact transfer.
scenarios.briefing: Ivara Blacktide must recover the drowned mirror chart before Sunvault fixes every wreck beneath its daylight registry.
scenarios.intel: Relay pickets and mirror lancers protect the final survey record; Orevein's clause proves Bellwake has standing to claim it.
scenarios.stakes: Enter the wreck claim and all three routes become one frontier record; fail and Sunvault erases the chain in daylight.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: The drowned chart enters Bellwake's vault beside the Mireford mark and Orevein writ, completing the frontier docket.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: Sunvault strips the chart from the wreck lane and leaves the three claims legally and strategically divided.
scenarios.journal_victory: Ivara entered the final wreck claim and closed the three-command frontier record.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Ivara failed to recover the final frontier record.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: Two massive living roots cross beneath and split an iron toll gate and its barrier.
scenarios.label: Chapter IV: Rootgate Toll
scenarios.description: Carry the drowned chart back inland, break Clauseworks' toll line, and root a fourth claim through the nursery road.
scenarios.status_hint: Tova receives bounded Bellwake stores and evidence while retaining her own Thornwake command state.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports bounded Bellwake resources and flags, then exports common stores and the rooted toll record toward Fogchart without cross-faction personal progression.
scenarios.briefing: Tova Rootwright must turn the drowned survey record into a living road before Clauseworks prices every inland crossing shut.
scenarios.intel: Charter guards, bastion reserves, and boiler exactors hold the contract road; Bellwake's chart proves the toll was built across the shared claim.
scenarios.stakes: Root Clauseworks into the living road and the four claims become one durable frontier record; fail and the chain ends at the coast.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Clauseworks' ledgers are bound beneath Rootgate and the four-command frontier docket becomes a living route.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: Brasshollow closes the toll line and strands the three earlier claims beyond Rootgate's uprooted road.
scenarios.journal_victory: Tova broke the Rootgate toll and rooted the fourth frontier claim.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Tova failed to bind Clauseworks into the frontier route.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A rope-looped mooring post stands above a sinking chart scroll amid three fog wisps.
scenarios.label: Chapter V: Fogchart Mooring
scenarios.description: Carry Rootgate's recorded claim back into the mist, break Sunvault's chart-seizure line, and anchor a fifth claim at Fogchart Mooring.
scenarios.status_hint: Ruln receives bounded Rootgate common stores and evidence while retaining his own Veilmourn command state.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports bounded Rootgate common resources and flags, then exports common stores and the drowned registry record toward Clauseworks without cross-faction personal progression.
scenarios.briefing: Ruln Vanehook must turn Rootgate's recorded toll claim into a drowned chart before Sunvault fixes Fogchart's hidden wreck lane in daylight.
scenarios.intel: Relay pickets, mirror lancers, and an aurora battery guard the Halo registry front; Rootgate's ledger proves the daylight claim crosses Fogchart water.
scenarios.stakes: Sink the registry and all five claims become one durable frontier chart; fail and Sunvault closes the final mist route.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: The Halo registry is drowned beneath Fogchart's bell chain and the five-command frontier docket becomes a complete chart.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: Sunvault fixes the wreck lane in daylight and strands the earlier claims beyond Fogchart's silenced mooring.
scenarios.journal_victory: Ruln drowned the Halo registry and anchored the fifth frontier claim at Fogchart.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Ruln failed to bind Fogchart into the frontier chart.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: Two opposing claim stamps split a folded docket and burst its central sealing wax.
scenarios.label: Chapter VI: Clauseworks Counterclaim
scenarios.description: Carry Fogchart's drowned registry inland, break Embercourt's audit line, and ratify a sixth claim from Clauseworks Depot.
scenarios.status_hint: Oren receives bounded Fogchart common stores and evidence while retaining his own Brasshollow command state.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports bounded Fogchart common resources and flags, then resolves the anthology without cross-faction hero, spell, artifact, or rare-resource transfer.
scenarios.briefing: Oren Bellfounder must turn Fogchart's drowned registry into a stamped counterclaim before Embercourt voids Clauseworks' right to the audit road.
scenarios.intel: Archive wardens, bridge levies, and beacon crews guard Highwater's audit front; Fogchart's ledger proves the charter crosses the shared claim.
scenarios.stakes: Stamp Highwater's audit into Clauseworks and all six claims become one ratified frontier record; fail and Embercourt voids the final counterclaim.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Highwater's audit is stamped into Clauseworks and the six-command frontier docket becomes a ratified route.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: Embercourt closes the audit road and strands the earlier claims beyond Clauseworks' silenced boilers.
scenarios.journal_victory: Oren stamped the Highwater audit and ratified the sixth frontier claim from Clauseworks.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Oren failed to bind Clauseworks into the final frontier record.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A chain shaped as a reversing arrow curls over an inverted dark-glass ledger and brass valve.
scenarios.label: Chapter VII: Nightglass Ledger Reversal
scenarios.description: Carry Clauseworks' stamped counterclaim into the marsh, break Brasshollow's ledger road, and record the seventh frontier claim from Nightglass Redoubt.
scenarios.status_hint: Kessa receives bounded Clauseworks common stores and evidence while retaining her own Mireclaw command state.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports bounded Clauseworks common resources and flags, then resolves the anthology without cross-faction hero, spell, artifact, or rare-resource transfer.
scenarios.briefing: Kessa Chainboom must reverse Clauseworks' stamped counterclaim before Brasshollow turns the marsh road into a permanent toll ledger.
scenarios.intel: Ledger guards, rivet auditors, and furnace exactors hold the Clauseworks counter-front; Oren's stamped record proves the disputed road reaches Nightglass.
scenarios.stakes: Reverse Clauseworks' ledger and all seven claims become one marsh-bound frontier record; fail and Brasshollow seals Nightglass behind its boiler tolls.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Clauseworks' counter-ledger is reversed beneath Nightglass wax and the seven-command frontier docket becomes a complete disputed record.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: Brasshollow closes the marsh docket and strands the earlier claims beyond Nightglass' silenced drums.
scenarios.journal_victory: Kessa reversed the Clauseworks ledger and recorded the seventh frontier claim from Nightglass.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Kessa failed to bind Nightglass into the final frontier record.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A brass halo lens bends one claim beam into three rays around a thorn-root obstruction.
scenarios.label: Chapter VIII: Halo Reserve Refraction Claim
scenarios.description: Carry Nightglass' reversed ledger to Halo Spire, break Thornwake's refracted root line, and record Sunvault's missing frontier claim.
scenarios.status_hint: Neral receives bounded Nightglass common stores and evidence while retaining his own Sunvault command state.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports bounded Nightglass common resources and flags, then resolves the anthology without cross-faction hero, spell, artifact, or rare-resource transfer.
scenarios.briefing: Neral Glasswind must refract Nightglass' reversed docket through Halo Spire before Thornwake roots the forest lens shut.
scenarios.intel: Seedcutters, thornwhip carriers, sporeglass menders, and barkmantle screens hold Rootgate's refraction front; Kessa's reversed ledger proves Sunvault belongs in the shared claim.
scenarios.stakes: Refract the Rootgate claim and all eight commands enter one frontier record; fail and Sunvault remains absent from the docket.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Rootgate's living claim is refracted through Halo Spire and the eight-command frontier docket becomes complete without merging its commanders.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: Thornwake closes the forest lens and leaves Sunvault outside the frontier record.
scenarios.journal_victory: Neral refracted the Rootgate claim and recorded Sunvault as the eighth frontier command.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Neral failed to bind Halo Spire into the frontier record.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A many-sided bastion bears a blank gold counterseal ringed by reed, stone, root, prism, ore, and parchment.
scenarios.label: Chapter IX: Charter Bastion Counterseal
scenarios.description: Carry Halo's refracted claim to Charter Bastion, break Sunvault's counterseal, and enter Embercourt as the ninth frontier command.
scenarios.status_hint: Seren receives bounded Halo common stores and evidence while retaining her own Embercourt command state.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports bounded Halo common resources and flags without cross-faction hero, spell, artifact, or rare-resource transfer.
scenarios.briefing: Seren Valechant must counterseal Halo Spire's lens docket before Sunvault closes Charter Bastion outside the shared claim.
scenarios.intel: Relay pickets, mirror lancers, and an aurora battery hold the counterseal causeway; Neral's refracted record proves Embercourt is the last absent command.
scenarios.stakes: Break the Halo counterseal and all six factions stand within nine frontier claims; fail and Embercourt remains outside the completed docket.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Seren stamps Charter Bastion into the shared record, completing nine claims across all six commands without merging their commanders.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: Sunvault closes the counterseal and leaves Charter Bastion beyond the frontier record.
scenarios.journal_victory: Seren broke Halo's counterseal and recorded Embercourt as the ninth frontier command.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Seren failed to bind Charter Bastion into the frontier record.

items.name: Briarwheel Covenant
items.description: Ardren Briar-Marshal reclaims Briarwheel Enclave, wakes the forgotten Rootway, and binds three scattered Thornwake holds into one living covenant.
items.summary: A three-chapter Thornwake campaign about recovering measured ground, carrying one commander's growth forward, and joining every Thornwake town through a living road.
items.region: Graftroot Verge, Briarwheel March, and the Worldroot Crown
items.emblem_alt_text: A living briar wheel carries three bright seed lanterns beneath branching crown roots.
items.arc_goal: Recover Briarwheel, wake the Rootway, and bind Graftroot, Rootgate, and Briarwheel into a covenant that no rival survey can divide.
items.completion_summary: Ardren binds all three Thornwake holds into one road covenant while preserving the old measures, awakened root paths, and fogline charts that keep it alive.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A living briar wheel breaks a brass chain above cracked boundary stones and one seed light.
scenarios.label: Chapter I: Briarwheel Reclamation
scenarios.description: Break the contract chain around Briarwheel, rehang the Old Measure Marker, and return the enclave to Thornwake hands.
scenarios.status_hint: Ardren begins at Graftroot with an intact Briar Cordon and no imported campaign state.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Exports Ardren's progression, spells, artifacts, bounded stores, and the reclaimed-measure record into the Rootway march.
scenarios.briefing: Brasshollow has priced Briarwheel out of its own soil and hung contract chains from every old measure. Ardren must cut the toll line without uprooting the road beneath it.
scenarios.intel: Archive wardens hold the central survey arch while exactors screen the enclave. The Old Measure Marker still remembers the boundary if its chains can be rehung.
scenarios.stakes: Briarwheel becomes the covenant's western root only if both enclave and measure survive the reclamation.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: The brass chain snaps, Briarwheel opens its living gate, and Ardren carries the restored measure east toward the buried Rootway.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The measure remains priced and Briarwheel's roots are cut into separate contract lots.
scenarios.journal_victory: Ardren reclaimed Briarwheel and rehung the Old Measure Marker.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Ardren failed to restore the western measure.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A walking living-root bridge carries graft shoots and a lit seed lantern across broken ground.
scenarios.label: Chapter II: Rootway Graftmarch
scenarios.description: Carry Briarwheel's restored measure through Sunvault's closure line and wake the buried Rootway before daylight fixes it shut.
scenarios.status_hint: Ardren continues with bounded stores and his own surviving command growth.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports Ardren's campaign state and exports it with the awakened Rootway record toward the Worldroot Crown.
scenarios.briefing: The restored measure points beneath a daylight survey that never accounted for living roads. Ardren must move the whole cordon as one graftmarch.
scenarios.intel: Relay pickets and an aurora battery bracket the Rootway Marker. Sunvault can close the route by pressure even if its forward town falls.
scenarios.stakes: Without the Rootway, Briarwheel and Rootgate remain two isolated defenses instead of one campaign road.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: The old roots rise beneath Ardren's column and carry the restored measure into the Worldroot basin.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: Sunvault fixes the route in glass and leaves Briarwheel beyond Rootgate's reach.
scenarios.journal_victory: Ardren woke the Rootway and carried the covenant east.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Ardren failed to open the living march.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: Three crown roots surround a bright heartwood seed where measured roads converge.
scenarios.label: Chapter III: Worldroot Crown Covenant
scenarios.description: Chart the last fogline, break the twin closure fronts, and bind all three Thornwake holds beneath the Worldroot Crown.
scenarios.status_hint: Ardren enters the largest board with his campaign command intact and two allied holds to defend.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports the full same-hero campaign state and resolves the covenant without exporting beyond this authored arc.
scenarios.briefing: Brass contracts and Sunvault lenses have met beneath the Worldroot Crown. Ardren must defend Rootgate, recover Graftroot, and chart the fogline that joins them to Briarwheel.
scenarios.intel: Two enemy towns drive separate raid clocks. The Fogline Marker lies between their closure fronts and is the only surviving chart through the crown roots.
scenarios.stakes: All three Thornwake holds stand or fall as one road; losing either allied root breaks the covenant before it is sworn.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: The fogline is charted, the rival fronts collapse, and three seed lights answer beneath one living crown.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The crown roots are partitioned and the awakened road withers between isolated holds.
scenarios.journal_victory: Ardren bound Graftroot, Rootgate, and Briarwheel into the living covenant.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Ardren failed to hold the three roots together.

items.name: Ashen Ledger
items.description: Daxis Chain-Captain rekindles Cindercoil, carries a moving contract road through the meridian, and binds all three Brasshollow hearths into one living industrial ledger.
items.summary: A three-chapter Brasshollow campaign about reclaiming production, carrying one commander's record, and joining three industrial towns through a mobile contract economy.
items.region: Cindercoil Line, Clauseworks Road, and the Three-Hearth Crown
items.emblem_alt_text: A black iron ledger is clasped by a glowing copper chain before a furnace heart and three contract tabs.
items.arc_goal: Rekindle Cindercoil, reopen the moving contract road, and bind Orevein, Clauseworks, and Cindercoil beneath one Ashen Ledger.
items.completion_summary: Daxis records three functioning hearths in one mobile ledger without surrendering the towns to rival tolls.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A black iron foundry gate opens around a bright coil as its copper foreclosure chain breaks.
scenarios.label: Chapter I: Cindercoil Reclamation
scenarios.description: Break the peat foreclosure and return Cindercoil Foundry to production.
scenarios.status_hint: Daxis begins with an intact contract train and Orevein's assay economy.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Exports Daxis's progression, relics, spells, stores, and rekindled-furnace record.
scenarios.briefing: Cindercoil's last furnace has gone dark beneath a peat foreclosure. Daxis must restore production without abandoning Orevein.
scenarios.intel: Mireclaw levies hold both approaches and feed wet fuel into the coil house.
scenarios.stakes: Without Cindercoil, Brasshollow has contracts but no heat to honor them.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Cindercoil burns again and the Ashen Ledger opens its first account.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The furnace drowns and Orevein's contract road fails.
scenarios.journal_victory: Cindercoil burns again and the Ashen Ledger opens its first account.
scenarios.journal_defeat: The furnace drowns and Orevein's contract road fails.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A riveted contract wagon carries a closed iron ledger and two gauge lanterns along a linked brass road.
scenarios.label: Chapter II: The Ashen Clausemarch
scenarios.description: Move the rekindled foundry train through Sunvault's seizure corridor and reopen Clauseworks.
scenarios.status_hint: Daxis continues with his command record and a mobile foundry train.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports Cindercoil's record and exports the cleared clause road with Daxis's continuing company.
scenarios.briefing: The Ashen Ledger cannot remain a stationary book. Daxis must carry it through the false certainty of the meridian line.
scenarios.intel: Relay screens can close behind the train even after its vanguard reaches Clauseworks.
scenarios.stakes: If the mobile foundry is fixed under glass, Cindercoil becomes an isolated victory.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: The clause road moves again and the ledger reaches the final accounting.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The meridian freezes the march and severs the three hearths.
scenarios.journal_victory: The clause road moves again and the ledger reaches the final accounting.
scenarios.journal_defeat: The meridian freezes the march and severs the three hearths.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: Three black anvils surround a brilliant furnace heart inside a circular copper oath-chain.
scenarios.label: Chapter III: Furnace Reckoning
scenarios.description: Recover Clauseworks and answer the drowned counterledger with one three-town industrial covenant.
scenarios.status_hint: Daxis enters with the complete Ashen Ledger and two developing industrial anchors.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports the complete Ashen Ledger and resolves the Brasshollow campaign arc.
scenarios.briefing: Rival claims have reached Clauseworks from water and mire. Daxis must make all three hearths answer the same accounting.
scenarios.intel: The counterledger attacks from two directions and can turn every delayed claim into pressure.
scenarios.stakes: One lost hearth divides Brasshollow's production into rival toll lots.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Three anvils answer one furnace heart and the Ashen Ledger closes in balance.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The ledger is divided and the industrial covenant fails.
scenarios.journal_victory: Three anvils answer one furnace heart and the Ashen Ledger closes in balance.
scenarios.journal_defeat: The ledger is divided and the industrial covenant fails.

items.name: Last Bell Sounding
items.description: Sael Mirrorbell calls Gloamwake out of silence, hunts a false channel through the mirrorwake, and makes all three Veilmourn harbors answer one final bell.
items.summary: A three-chapter Veilmourn campaign about reclaimed harbors, deceptive navigation, same-hero memory, and a three-town coastal covenant.
items.region: Gloamwake Reach, Mirrorwake Channel, and the Last-Bell Coast
items.emblem_alt_text: A silver-black harbor bell hangs over a dark tide mirror with three pale wake ripples and a mist ribbon.
items.arc_goal: Recall Gloamwake's bell, erase the false channel, and join Bellwake, Fogchart, and Gloamwake in one three-harbor sounding.
items.completion_summary: Sael's Last Bell crosses every harbor mirror and leaves a navigable record through the Veilmourn coast.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A drowned silver harbor bell rises on two ropes above a relit anchorage lamp.
scenarios.label: Chapter I: Gloamwake Recall
scenarios.description: Break the lock writ and return Gloamwake Anchorage to Veilmourn hands.
scenarios.status_hint: Sael begins with a mirror-navigation cadre and Bellwake's tide stores.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Exports Sael's progression, relics, spells, stores, and recalled-bell record.
scenarios.briefing: Gloamwake has been made silent by decree. Sael must recover its bell without losing Bellwake's living harbor.
scenarios.intel: Lock wardens hold two approaches and treat every unsounded tide as consent.
scenarios.stakes: Without Gloamwake's echo, the old channel vanishes from memory.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: The drowned bell sounds and Gloamwake remembers its harbor.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The lock writ seals the anchorage beyond recall.
scenarios.journal_victory: The drowned bell sounds and Gloamwake remembers its harbor.
scenarios.journal_defeat: The lock writ seals the anchorage beyond recall.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A sharp silver wake splits a dark tide mirror while three different buoys mark the true route.
scenarios.label: Chapter II: False Channel Pursuit
scenarios.description: Pursue the false meridian, recover Fogchart, and preserve the recalled echo.
scenarios.status_hint: Sael continues with the recalled bell and a growing memory-salt reserve.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports Gloamwake's sounding and exports the true-channel record with Sael's continuing cadre.
scenarios.briefing: A bright false channel now points every pilot toward prepared fire. Sael must navigate by memory, not glare.
scenarios.intel: The mirror screens can close the wake behind her and isolate Gloamwake again.
scenarios.stakes: If Fogchart reads the false meridian, all three harbors inherit a fatal route.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: The false channel breaks and Sael records the true mirrorwake.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The bright lie replaces the coast's remembered bearing.
scenarios.journal_victory: The false channel breaks and Sael records the true mirrorwake.
scenarios.journal_defeat: The bright lie replaces the coast's remembered bearing.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: Three silver-black harbor bells hang above linked moonlit pools joined by a sweeping mist ribbon.
scenarios.label: Chapter III: Three Harbors Sounding
scenarios.description: Recover Fogchart and make Gloamwake, Bellwake, and Fogchart answer one another.
scenarios.status_hint: Sael enters with the complete sounding record and two developing harbor anchors.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports the complete sounding record and resolves the Veilmourn campaign arc.
scenarios.briefing: Foreclosure chains have reached Fogchart while lock wardens close the rear water. Sael must ring all three harbors as one coast.
scenarios.intel: Two enemy ledgers can turn delayed echoes into separate claims against each harbor.
scenarios.stakes: A silent harbor divides the coast and leaves the Last Bell unanswered.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Three harbors answer across one tide mirror and the Last Bell becomes a living route.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The bells fall silent in separate claims.
scenarios.journal_victory: Three harbors answer across one tide mirror and the Last Bell becomes a living route.
scenarios.journal_defeat: The bells fall silent in separate claims.
